summary: The reader is an undergraduate in computer science who has taken discrete mathematics, algorithms and a theory-of-computation course, with linear algebra and basic probability or number theory. They know asymptotic analysis, divide-and-conquer recurrences, binary and positional number representations, modular arithmetic, and sets and functions, and have met the idea of a fast Fourier transform and the n log n multiplication story at most informally. They have not studied finite fields, abstract algebra beyond basics, numerical error analysis, or the specialist literature on multiplication algorithms.

known.name: Linear algebra over the reals and rationals
known.gloss: Vectors, matrices, linear maps, invertibility, subspaces, dimension and rank over a field such as the rationals or reals.

known.name: Modular arithmetic and congruences
known.gloss: Arithmetic on integers modulo n, with remainders and congruence.

known.name: Primes, coprimality and gcd
known.gloss: Prime numbers, divisibility, and integers sharing no common factor.

known.name: Binary representation and bit operations
known.gloss: Writing integers in base 2, and bitwise operations such as exclusive or.

known.name: Radix (base-b) positional representation
known.gloss: Writing a nonnegative integer as a sum of digits times powers of a base.

known.name: Floor, ceiling and logarithms
known.gloss: Rounding functions and base-2 logarithms, with lg n as the binary logarithm.

known.name: Divide-and-conquer recurrences
known.gloss: Cost of a recursive algorithm expressed as a recurrence solved by unrolling or the master theorem.

known.name: Fixed-point arithmetic and rounding error
known.gloss: Representing real numbers with a fixed number of fractional bits, with bounded error from rounding.

known.name: Complex exponential and unit roots
known.gloss: The complex exponential e^{iθ} and the N-th roots of unity on the unit circle.

known.name: Cyclic groups and cyclic indexing
known.gloss: Indices taken modulo n so the last position wraps to the first.

known.name: Cartesian products and multidimensional arrays
known.gloss: Arrays indexed by tuples of coordinates, stored in lexicographic order.

known.name: Permutations
known.gloss: Bijections of a finite set, which reorder the entries of an array.

known.name: Gaussian elimination and triangular matrices
known.gloss: Row reduction and matrices with zeros above the diagonal.

known.name: Gaussian function
known.gloss: The bell-shaped function exp(-x^2), with its standard integral and decay.

known.name: Time complexity and reductions
known.gloss: Worst-case step counts and reducing one problem to another.

known.name: Basic induction and proof by contradiction
known.gloss: Standard proof methods used in the paper's lemmas.

known.name: Basic set notation and counting
known.gloss: Sets, subsets, cardinality and simple counting.

known.name: Fast Fourier transform idea
known.gloss: The standard n log n algorithm for the discrete Fourier transform by splitting into half-size transforms.
